title: Underwriting Desk Note on the Mortgage Loan File: Credit Supplement for New Inquiries on a Repulled Report
content:
Each credit inquiry explanation condition issued on a Mortgage Loan File stands for a new account the bureaus must document, so a credit report repull on the file carries a credit supplement priced by how many such conditions have been issued:

- where two or more credit inquiry explanation conditions have been issued on the file, the repull carries a supplement of **45.00 USD**;
- where exactly one has been issued, it carries a supplement of **25.00 USD**;
- where none has been issued, it carries no supplement.

The count is of credit inquiry explanation conditions issued on the file in its underwriting conditions; a condition that has been issued remains one that has been issued after it is cleared or waived.

| Credit inquiry explanation conditions issued on the file | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 25.00 USD |
| 2 | 45.00 USD |
| 3 or more | 45.00 USD |

Hypothetical case: a file on which underwriting issued one credit inquiry explanation condition in March and a second in April carries a supplement of 45.00 USD on a repull, the multiple-inquiry figure, not 25.00 USD twice.
